Quote of the day by Socrates: 'It is a shame to grow old without seeing the beauty and strength your body is capable of' - Life lesson on how to reach your full potential by ancient Greek philosopher
description: Quote of the day by Socrates: The ancient Greek philosopher believed physical training was not just about appearance but a responsibility towards oneself. Recorded by Xenophon in Memorabilia, Socrates’ words explain why people should strive to discover the strength and abilities their bodies are capable of achieving. The quote also reflects his larger philosophy of discipline, self-improvement and living a life of constant growth.

title: Ancient mummy DNA provides scientific evidence that colonization brought smallpox to the Americas
description: Ancient mummy DNA recovered in Chile has yielded the firmest evidence yet that European colonization brought smallpox to the Americas.
